meta.title: Details of Claims Development and Aging — Health Insurance Business (excluding Travel and Personal Accident)

aging_notes.paid: Paid-claim aging is reckoned from the date of first intimation.
aging_notes.repudiated: Repudiated-claim aging is reckoned from the date of receipt of the last requirement.
aging_notes.outstanding: Outstanding-claim aging is reckoned from the date of receipt of the last requirement.

limitations: Annual flows are not a single claim cohort: claims paid or repudiated in a year may have been registered in earlier years.
Table 66 is industry-level data, not insurer-level data.
Count and amount are separate measures and must not be mixed.
The source may not fully reconcile under a simple opening + new = paid + repudiated + closing equation. Values are preserved as reported; no balancing adjustments are made.
